audit_name: Day 22 Checkpoint 023 Microscopic Model Audit (CF22 & SHJ24)

cf22_audit.method: Spin coherent state (SCS) representation of reduced density matrices on 2D sphere
cf22_audit.low_spin_topology: Zero-phonon blob and one-phonon rim centered on short axis (TW)
cf22_audit.intermediate_instability: At I ~ 29/2 hbar, classical frozen-alignment predicts instability; quantum fluctuations delay it into a transitional flip mode
cf22_audit.high_spin_topology: Shifts toward intermediate axis revolution (longitudinal-like topology)
cf22_audit.sp_mixing: Signature-partner (SP) mode mixes strongly with wobbling near instability; phonon number n loses exact meaning outside stable low-spin TW
cf22_audit.experimental_input_dependency: Uses Matta 2015 large-E2 parameters as input; does not independently determine delta; superseded when Lv 2022 established small root (88% M1)

shj24_audit.method: Three-dimensional angular momentum projection from deformed Nilsson-BCS states
shj24_audit.data_provenance: Reuses experimental datasets from Biswas 2019 (133La) and Matta 2015 / Sensharma 2019 (135Pr)
limitations: Fixed triaxial deformation is an input basis parameter, not an experimental observable
Model reproduced legacy large-root E2 ratios; does not evaluate Lv 2022 small-root P-Rac measurement
Authors explicitly acknowledge that two-phonon assignments remain tentative pending definitive electromagnetic transition measurements

hierarchy_conclusion.statement: Microscopic and projected models (TPSM, SCS-PTR, PRM) are capable of fitting both wobbling and signature-partner curves depending on the adopted interband multipolarity
hierarchy_conclusion.gate_priority: Experimental multipolarity root selection (|delta| < 1 vs |delta| > 1) via calibrated polarization or conversion electrons strictly precedes and gates theoretical model classification
hierarchy_conclusion.falsification_impact: When Lv 2022, Guo 2022, and Mukhopadhyay 2008 establish M1 dominance and B(E2) collapse, theoretical models must redirect from collective wobbling to tilted precession (TiP), single-particle orbital excitation, or configuration mixing
